Pressure_monitoring_sensor.label: Pressure monitoring sensor
Pressure_monitoring_sensor.description: The uCIFI water pressure monitoring sensor measures water pressure and help identify water leaks in water distribution pipelines.

Pressure.label: Pressure
Pressure.description: Last or current pressure value measured by the sensor.

Sampling_period.label: Sampling period
Sampling_period.description: Number of seconds between two measurement.

Leak_detected.label: Leak detected
Leak_detected.description: Set to True if a water leak is detected by the sensor.

Hammer_effect_detected.label: Hammer effect detected
Hammer_effect_detected.description: Set to True if hammer effect is detected in the water pipeline.

Minimum_measured_pressure_value.label: Minimum measured pressure value
Minimum_measured_pressure_value.description: Minimum value measured by the sensor since power ON or reset.

Maximum_measured_pressure_value.label: Maximum measured pressure value
Maximum_measured_pressure_value.description: Maximum value measured by the sensor since power ON or reset.

Minimum_range_pressure_value.label: Minimum range pressure value
Minimum_range_pressure_value.description: Minimum value that can be measured by the sensor.

Maximum_range_pressure_value.label: Maximum range pressure value
Maximum_range_pressure_value.description: Maximum value that can be measured by the sensor.

Reset_min_and_max_measured_pressure_valu.label: Reset min and max measured pressure values
Reset_min_and_max_measured_pressure_valu.description: Set the minimum and maximum measured values to current value.
